label: Dupe-Probe: one empty comment, imported twice, to see which copy keeps the name (1 action)

p.WFCommentActionText: Import this twice. The second copy arrives as "Dupe-Probe 1" and the first keeps the clean name, so every shortcuts://run-shortcut?name=Dupe-Probe link and every runworkflow card naming it keeps resolving to the OLD copy. That is why anything generated from this repo is deleted before it is re-imported (CLAUDE.md, "Installing is an import, not a paste").
